handwritten_scope_decision.why_simulated_span_edit_does_not_solve_e: On `ext_hw_b1_01_hd_a_6043187` (`CER = 0.6143`), cursive notebook lines are broken into 23 uncertain spans plus corrupted intermediate words; character-aligned span substitution without re-transcribing the cursive page leaves residual cursive OCR noise (`LOCAL_PARSE_PARTIAL` -> `LIVE_AI_DISABLED`), confirming that full-page cursive handwriting requires Vision fallback or full text editing rather than local OCR.
